These are native-component subsets extracted from Grasshopper-produced files
in McNeel's rhinocodetests repository, branch rhino-9.x, retrieved 2026-09-07.
The serialized Object chunks (component GUIDs, port InstanceGuids, input data,
positions, slider settings and wires) are retained from the originals. Only
unrelated objects, archive thumbnail and unused library metadata are removed.
They were not generated by the Mantis GHX writer.

- mcneel_sliders_series.ghx: files/gh1/test_python_range.ghx
- mcneel_circle_unit_z.ghx: files/gh1/test_ghscript_constraints_error.ghx
- mcneel_text.ghx: files/gh1/test_ghscript_embedded.ghx (one persistent Text
  parameter, including its `null_string` metadata; content stays an inert string)

Source: https://github.com/mcneel/rhinocodetests/tree/rhino-9.x
